generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
All 20 tests pass. The implementation is complete and correct. Here's a summary of what's in `output/`:

- **`main.js`** — CLI entry point; handles `--input`, `--output`, `--tool-table`, `--parameter-input/output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--trace-*` options; exits 0/1/2
- **`interpreter.js`** — RS274/NGC execution engine; full Table 8 execution order; G0/1/2/3 motion, G4 dwell, G10 coordinate data, G17-19 plane selection, G20/21 units, G28/30 home, G38.2 probe, G40-42 CRC, G43/49 TLO, G53 machine coords, G54-G59.3 coord systems, G80-89 canned cycles, G90/91 distance modes, G92/92.1/92.2 offsets, G93/94 feed modes, G98/99 canned retract; M0-5/8-9/30 miscellaneous codes
- **`tracer.js`** — delta-encoded time-ordered trace; three sampling modes (time-step, distance-step, position-tolerance); integer step counter for clean time values
- **`machine.js`** — machine state model (pre-existing)
- **`parser.js`** — G-code parser with expression evaluator (pre-existing)
- **`utils.js`** — math utilities (pre-existing)
- **`crc.js`** — CRC geometry helpers (exported, geometry-only)

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
